conclusions: Each pointer is reconciled to a real local Parquet payload with matching LFS SHA256 and declared size; absence is not inferred from pointer bytes.
The 45 embedding payloads export no job identity or explicit request/GPU/resource string fields. Their submissions end on 2025-03-10, before every April recovery target.
The two power-result payloads contain only avg_power_per_node and predicted_power; neither identity nor resource requests are exported.
Both historic traces export job_id and submission/start fields but have zero exact ID/submission/start matches against all 16574 target UIDs; submission coverage ends on 2025-03-10.
No historical scheduler policy, requested-walltime service, similarity inference, embedding decoding or power-derived GPU inference is used.
